scope.summary: oracle_semantic_search with query_vector now proves the native VECTOR capability from COMPATIBLE and returns the stable typed requires_23ai refusal before any relation/column resolution, so a pre-23ai server no longer reports a misleading OBJECT_NOT_FOUND for its VEC_VAL column.
out_of_scope: crates/oraclemcp/src/dispatch/tests.rs is held by another agent and was not edited; the query_vector pre-23ai ordering is covered by the new inline pure unit tests plus the live W4 case instead.
The query_text 23.4 in-database-embedding gate still runs in semantic_search_text_model after relation resolution; only its helper was refactored, not reordered.
The live W4 result JSON lives under the gitignored target/e2e/w4/ tree and is not committed as a live artifact; this close claims scoped-test readiness, not live-evidence readiness.
No change to the SQL guard/classifier or the read-only admission path.

entry_points.name: oracle_semantic_search (query_vector) MCP tool
entry_points.trace: Unit: cargo test -p oraclemcp --lib semantic_search_capability_tests -> vector_capability_gate_refuses_every_pre_23ai_compatible + in_database_embedding_gate_still_requires_the_23_4_minimum. Live W4: scripts/e2e/w4/driver.py --lane xe18 --case w4_semantic_search_unsupported_version_typed_refusal returned RUNTIME_STATE_REQUIRED/requires_23ai (pre-change it returned OBJECT_NOT_FOUND); same on xe21; free23 --case w4_semantic_search_ranked_results_23ai still returned row_count 3.

entry_points.name: offline registry routing test
entry_points.trace: At the fix commit: cargo test -p oraclemcp --lib => 541 passed, 0 failed, including every_registry_tool_routes_and_deserializes_offline which now expects ErrorClass::RuntimeStateRequired for oracle_semantic_search offline.

limitations: Readiness basis is scoped-test: the inline unit tests exercise the COMPATIBLE version arithmetic, and the live W4 cases were run manually against xe18/xe21/free23 but their JSON output is under the gitignored target/ tree, so it is not a committed exact-SHA live artifact.
The planted negative (forcing compatible_supports_vector to admit every value) was a temporary local build and was reverted before the work commit; it is not present in source.sha.
The query_vector capability probe adds one extra catalog round-trip (v$parameter compatible) before relation resolution on 23ai; it is the same closed catalog query the query_text path already uses.
No independent verifier re-ran the change; the swarm verifier must re-execute before closing.
Correction: the original close omitted the affected offline routing test; the behaviour change and its test update are now landed together (rule 11).
